about_the_game:
Beat Vortex is a physics-driven rhythm game where you fly freely through a twisting, music-reactive tunnel—like if a flight sim and a music game had a baby.

Where most rhythm games rely on hand-built levels or rigid tracks, Beat Vortex analyzes your music and builds a playable level on the fly. Just load a song, and within seconds you're soaring through a unique, beat-matched world shaped by your favorite tracks.

Unlike games that lock you to a rail, you have full control of your ship—roll, tilt, dive, and glide with full 360° freedom. It feels less like you're pressing buttons to the beat and more like you're flying through the music.

Whether you're chasing high scores, zoning out to your favorite album, or watching someone else experience it for the first time, Beat Vortex is built to be accessible and rewarding at any skill level. Difficulty and speed sliders help players of all kinds find their groove.

Right now, it’s more of a music experience tool than a traditional game, but I plan to change that. Campaign Mode, Time Trials (with ghosts), and even Co-op are all in the works. Quick Play will always be there for the arcade-style jump-in-and-fly fun.

If you enjoy high-speed rhythm games or free-flying action, you'll likely find something special here too.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel Iris Xe
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

short_description: Discover a new way to experience your music in Beat Vortex, a rhythm game where your favorite songs shape the world. Fly through twisting tunnels that pulse, bend, and react to every beat. You’ll dodge, roll, and flow in sync with the rhythm—chasing high scores or just vibing to the music you love.
